## `inventory_operations` — 库存作业单

| 项目 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| Schema | <code>public</code> |
| 分类 | Source Document / 源单据 |
| 用途 | 保存盘点、调拨和手工调整的来源作业、原因、明细与审批阶段。 |
| 明确不负责 | 作业单本身不是库存余额；只有 POSTED 才由同一事务写 inventory_txns。 |
| 生命周期 / 删除语义 | 普通盘点或调拨可由 DRAFT 直接 POSTED；手工调整经 DRAFT、SUBMITTED、APPROVED 或 REJECTED 后过账；允许受控 CANCELLED；不物理删除。 |
| 写入边界 | InventoryUsecase 创建、过账和取消；手工调整提交、审批、拒绝和过账由 ProcessRuntime 白名单命令执行。 |
| 审查备注 | schema 明确称其为 auditable source document；目录按“先承载作业意图、过账后另写 inventory_txns”归 Source Document。 |

无外键。

### 索引

| 索引 | 唯一 | 字段 | Predicate |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <code>inventoryoperation_created_by_idempotency_key</code> | 是 | <code>created_by</code>, <code>idempotency_key</code> | — |
| <code>inventoryoperation_operation_no</code> | 是 | <code>operation_no</code> | — |
| <code>inventoryoperation_operation_type_status_created_at</code> | 否 | <code>operation_type</code>, <code>status</code>, <code>created_at</code> | — |

### CHECK 约束

- <code>inventory_operations_approval_bundle</code>

```sql
((operation_type <> 'MANUAL_ADJUSTMENT' AND submitted_at IS NULL AND submitted_by IS NULL AND approved_at IS NULL AND approved_by IS NULL AND rejected_at IS NULL AND rejected_by IS NULL AND reject_reason IS NULL) OR (operation_type = 'MANUAL_ADJUSTMENT' AND ((status = 'DRAFT' AND submitted_at IS NULL AND submitted_by IS NULL AND approved_at IS NULL AND approved_by IS NULL AND rejected_at IS NULL AND rejected_by IS NULL AND reject_reason IS NULL) OR (status = 'SUBMITTED' AND submitted_at IS NOT NULL AND submitted_by IS NOT NULL AND approved_at IS NULL AND approved_by IS NULL AND rejected_at IS NULL AND rejected_by IS NULL AND reject_reason IS NULL) OR (status IN ('APPROVED', 'POSTED') AND submitted_at IS NOT NULL AND submitted_by IS NOT NULL AND approved_at IS NOT NULL AND approved_by IS NOT NULL AND approved_by <> created_by AND rejected_at IS NULL AND rejected_by IS NULL AND reject_reason IS NULL) OR (status = 'REJECTED' AND submitted_at IS NOT NULL AND submitted_by IS NOT NULL AND approved_at IS NULL AND approved_by IS NULL AND rejected_at IS NOT NULL AND rejected_by IS NOT NULL AND rejected_by <> created_by AND reject_reason IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(reject_reason)) > 0) OR (status = 'CANCELLED' AND ((submitted_at IS NULL AND submitted_by IS NULL AND approved_at IS NULL AND approved_by IS NULL AND rejected_at IS NULL AND rejected_by IS NULL AND reject_reason IS NULL) OR (submitted_at IS NOT NULL AND submitted_by IS NOT NULL AND approved_at IS NULL AND approved_by IS NULL AND rejected_at IS NULL AND rejected_by IS NULL AND reject_reason IS NULL) OR (submitted_at IS NOT NULL AND submitted_by IS NOT NULL AND approved_at IS NOT NULL AND approved_by IS NOT NULL AND approved_by <> created_by AND rejected_at IS NULL AND rejected_by IS NULL AND reject_reason IS NULL))))))
```

- <code>inventory_operations_cancel_bundle</code>

```sql
((status = 'CANCELLED' AND cancelled_at IS NOT NULL AND cancelled_by IS NOT NULL AND cancel_reason IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(cancel_reason)) > 0) OR (status <> 'CANCELLED' AND cancelled_at IS NULL AND cancelled_by IS NULL AND cancel_reason IS NULL))
```

- <code>inventory_operations_intent_bundle</code>

```sql
length(trim(idempotency_key)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND length(idempotency_payload_hash) = 64 AND idempotency_item_count > 0
```

- <code>inventory_operations_post_bundle</code>

```sql
((status = 'POSTED' AND posted_at IS NOT NULL AND posted_by IS NOT NULL) OR (status <> 'POSTED' AND posted_at IS NULL AND posted_by IS NULL) OR (status = 'CANCELLED' AND posted_at IS NOT NULL AND posted_by IS NOT NULL))
```

- <code>inventory_operations_status_allowed</code>

```sql
status IN ('DRAFT', 'SUBMITTED', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'POSTED', 'CANCELLED')
```

- <code>inventory_operations_type_allowed</code>

```sql
operation_type IN ('CYCLE_COUNT', 'TRANSFER', 'MANUAL_ADJUSTMENT')
```

- <code>inventory_operations_version_positive</code>

```sql
version > 0
```

## `purchase_receipt_adjustments` — 采购入库调整单

| 项目 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| Schema | <code>public</code> |
| 分类 | Source Document / 源单据 |
| 用途 | 保存采购入库数量、批次或仓库纠正的可审计调整来源单。 |
| 明确不负责 | 调整不改写原采购入库单和原库存流水，而是显式过账后产生新的修正流水。 |
| 生命周期 / 删除语义 | DRAFT 转 POSTED；DRAFT 可 CANCELLED，POSTED 取消通过 REVERSAL 后转 CANCELLED；不可删除。 |

### CHECK 约束

- <code>purchase_receipt_adjustments_idempotency_bundle_complete</code>

```sql
(
  (
    idempotency_key IS NULL
    AND idempotency_payload_hash IS NULL
    AND idempotency_item_count IS NULL
  )
  OR
  (
    idempotency_key IS NOT NULL
    AND length(trim(idempotency_key)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128
    AND idempotency_payload_hash IS NOT NULL
    AND length(idempotency_payload_hash) = 64
    AND idempotency_item_count IS NOT NULL
    AND idempotency_item_count > 0
  )
)
```

### CHECK 约束

- <code>purchase_returns_idempotency_bundle_complete</code>

```sql
(
  (
    idempotency_key IS NULL
    AND idempotency_payload_hash IS NULL
    AND idempotency_item_count IS NULL
  )
  OR
  (
    idempotency_key IS NOT NULL
    AND length(trim(idempotency_key)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128
    AND idempotency_payload_hash IS NOT NULL
    AND length(idempotency_payload_hash) = 64
    AND idempotency_item_count IS NOT NULL
    AND idempotency_item_count > 0
  )
)
```

## `quality_inspections` — 质量检验

| 项目 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| Schema | <code>public</code> |
| 分类 | Fact / 事实 |
| 用途 | 保存采购、委外、客户退货或生产 WIP 的质量检查、结论和纠正链。 |
| 明确不负责 | 质检只改变质量或批次/WIP 可用状态，不直接增加或扣减库存数量。 |
| 生命周期 / 删除语义 | DRAFT 转 SUBMITTED，再 PASSED 或 REJECTED；DRAFT 或 SUBMITTED 可 CANCELLED；纠错以 superseding 新检验保留原记录；不可删除。 |
| 写入边界 | InventoryUsecase 创建、提交、判定和取消；ProcessRuntime 可调用受控质量领域命令。 |

### 字段

| 字段 | PostgreSQL 类型 | Ent 类型 | NULL | 数据库默认值 | 结构属性 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <code>id</code> | <code>bigint</code> | <code>int</code> | 非空 | — | 主键；identity | 数据库主键；只用于内部关联，不等同于业务编号。 |
| <code>inspection_no</code> | <code>varchar(64)</code> | <code>string</code> | 非空 | — | — | 业务编号；唯一性和生成规则见索引与领域 usecase。 |

### CHECK 约束

- <code>quality_inspections_defect_rate_bundle_complete</code>

```sql
(
  (
    defect_rate_operator IS NULL
    AND defect_rate_percent IS NULL
  )
  OR
  (
    defect_rate_operator IS NOT NULL
    AND defect_rate_percent IS NOT NULL
  )
)
```

- <code>quality_inspections_defect_rate_gt_below_100</code>

```sql
defect_rate_operator IS NULL OR defect_rate_operator <> 'GT' OR defect_rate_percent < 100
```

- <code>quality_inspections_defect_rate_operator_valid</code>

```sql
defect_rate_operator IS NULL OR defect_rate_operator IN ('APPROX', 'GT')
```

- <code>quality_inspections_defect_rate_percent_range</code>

```sql
defect_rate_percent IS NULL OR (defect_rate_percent >= 0 AND defect_rate_percent <= 100)
```

- <code>quality_inspections_production_gate_allowed</code>

```sql
gate_code IS NULL OR gate_code IN ('CUT_PIECE', 'SHELL', 'FINISHED_GOODS', 'NEEDLE', 'SAMPLING', 'CUSTOMER_ACCEPTANCE')
```

- <code>quality_inspections_source_shape</code>

```sql
(
  (
    production_wip_batch_id IS NULL
    AND gate_code IS NULL
    AND inventory_lot_id IS NOT NULL
    AND warehouse_id IS NOT NULL
  )
  OR
  (
    production_wip_batch_id IS NOT NULL
    AND gate_code IS NOT NULL
    AND source_type IS NOT NULL
    AND source_type = 'PRODUCTION_WIP'
    AND source_id IS NOT NULL
    AND source_id = production_wip_batch_id
    AND inspection_type IS NOT NULL
    AND inspection_type = 'PRODUCTION_STAGE'
    AND subject_type IS NOT NULL
    AND subject_type = 'WIP'
    AND subject_id IS NOT NULL
    AND subject_id = production_wip_batch_id
    AND inventory_lot_id IS NULL
    AND warehouse_id IS NULL
    AND purchase_receipt_id IS NULL
    AND purchase_receipt_item_id IS NULL
    AND material_id IS NULL
  )
)
```

- <code>quality_inspections_superseded_bundle</code>

```sql
((superseded_at IS NULL AND superseded_by IS NULL AND superseded_reason IS NULL) OR (superseded_at IS NOT NULL AND superseded_by IS NOT NULL AND superseded_reason IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(superseded_reason)) > 0))
```

<a id="table-stock-reservations"></a>

## `stock_reservations` — 库存预留

| 项目 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| Schema | <code>public</code> |
| 分类 | Fact / 事实 |
| 用途 | 保存销售订单或显式需求对库存可用量的数量预留。 |
| 明确不负责 | ACTIVE 影响可用量但不产生 inventory_txns；只有出货消费才在同一事务扣减真实库存。 |
| 生命周期 / 删除语义 | ACTIVE 转 RELEASED、CONSUMED 或 CANCELLED；终态不重开，不物理删除。 |
| 写入边界 | OperationalFactUsecase 创建和释放；出货事务原子消费。 |
